title: Expanding OpenAI’s presence in Brazil
summary: OpenAI is expanding its presence in Brazil, deepening engagement with developers, businesses, and communities to support AI adoption across the country.
body: OpenAI is expanding its presence in Brazil, deepening engagement with developers, businesses, and communities to support AI adoption across the country.
summaryZh: OpenAI官方宣布进一步扩大其在巴西的业务布局，旨在深化与当地开发者、企业及社区的合作。此举有助于加速大模型技术在拉丁美洲市场的普及与应用，支持当地AI产业生态的成长。原始信息显示：OpenAI is expanding its presence in Brazil, deepening engagement with developers, businesses, and communities to support AI adoption across the country.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Expanding OpenAI’s presence in Brazil”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI宣布在巴西扩展业务并深化本地生态合作，推动大模型在拉丁美洲的实际落地。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
